answer: Every identity pays in thought each round. Because the ripple is unpredictable in advance, answers cannot be bought wholesale and replayed. Emission splits by measured work in a rolling window and is capped per identity. Splitting one worker into fifty wallets leaves the cluster's combined share flat, so extra fable buys dilution rather than income while the operator pays fifty times the generation cost. So a thread of identities is a subscription, not an acquisition: it bills the operator every epoch and refunds nothing when the panel disagrees. Seal 1b0vf.
